parameters.query: SELECT c.bot_id, c.user_id, c.max_id, c.last_id, c.current_summary, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_program tp WHERE tp.bot_id = c.bot_id AND tp.user_id = c.user_id AND tp.status = 'active') AS has_program, (SELECT string_agg(CASE WHEN h2.message->>'type'='human' THEN 'КЛИЕНТ: ' ELSE 'БОТ: ' END || left(h2.message->>'content',2000), E'\n' ORDER BY h2.id) FROM n8n_chat_histories h2 WHERE h2.session_id = c.bot_id||':'||c.user_id AND h2.id > c.last_id AND h2.id <= c.max_id AND h2.message->>'type' IN ('human','ai')) AS transcript FROM (SELECT split_part(h.session_id,':',1) AS bot_id, split_part(h.session_id,':',2)::bigint AS user_id, max(h.id) AS max_id, coalesce(max(es.last_message_id),0) AS last_id, max(cs.summary_text) AS current_summary FROM n8n_chat_histories h LEFT JOIN extraction_state es ON es.bot_id=split_part(h.session_id,':',1) AND es.user_id=split_part(h.session_id,':',2)::bigint LEFT JOIN client_summary cs ON cs.bot_id=split_part(h.session_id,':',1) AND cs.user_id=split_part(h.session_id,':',2)::bigint WHERE h.session_id ~ '^[^:]+:[0-9]+$' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING max(h.id) > coalesce(max(es.last_message_id),0)) c;
